t: r/floorplan on Reddit: is there any way to calculate the length of this wall?
s: September 7, 2022 - Let’s imagine 7 units of your folded length of string are equal to the unknown wall and 11 of those same units are the length of the known 128” bedroom wall. The formula then is 128/11 = x/7 (where x is the unknown you are solving for) So 128 times 7 equals 896 then divide that by 11 and the example answer is 81.45 inches.
